instruction.name: vssrlni.h.w
instruction.description: Logical right shift the unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` and `b` by `imm`, saturate the result to signed 16-bit, write the 16-bit result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vssrlni.h.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vssrlni.h.w $vr7, $vr15, 1
